decision_matrix.option_name: Option A: Early 'Blend-and-Extend' Inquiry -> Sale & IRC §1031 Diversified Exchange (2027–2028)
decision_matrix.rationale: Approaching JACK now for a 10–15 yr extension lifts sale price ~7.5%+ via cap compression (5.85% vs 6.55%) if accepted, or gives early warning if store is slated for closure; §1031 defers ~35.5% tax and eliminates single-tenant & LA seismic concentration.
decision_matrix.source_label: IRS Form 8824 (§1031) & SEC NNN REIT Form 10-K (2025)

decision_matrix.option_name: Option B: Direct Pre-Cliff Sale (2027, >=5 Yrs Left) + IRC §1031 Multi-Market Exchange
decision_matrix.rationale: Best choice if lease expires 2030–2031 or tenant declines early extension. Captures financeable NNN buyer pool before <4-yr cliff, preserves 100% of tax-deferred equity, and boosts cash yield into ~7.1% diversified net-lease assets.
decision_matrix.source_label: IRS Form 8824 (§1031) & CA FTB Form 3840 Instructions

decision_matrix.option_name: Option D: Passive Hold Through 2030–2035 Expiration & Renew at Market
decision_matrix.rationale: Preserves Prop 13 low tax base, but leaves 100% of wealth exposed to JACK credit (-4.2% SSS, block closures), AB 1228 margin pressure, dark-store TI/carry risk (P10 drops sharply), and unhedged Central LA Puente Hills seismic risk.
decision_matrix.source_label: SEC Form 10-Q (July 5, 2026) — Jack in the Box Inc. & USGS UCERF3

decision_matrix.option_name: Option E: Hold to Expiration & Reposition / Ground-Lease / Mixed-Use Infill Redevelopment
decision_matrix.rationale: Viable ONLY if parcel is a large (>=25,000 sq ft) signalized transit corner where underlying Central LA land value exceeds NNN leased-fee value; exposes individual investor to multi-year LA permitting, construction cost, and zero-income downtime.
decision_matrix.source_label: Los Angeles Department of City Planning — LAMC §12.24-W,17

decision_matrix.option_name: Option C: Outright Taxable Cash Sale Before Expiration (No §1031 Exchange)
decision_matrix.risk_profile: Low Operational Risk, Severe Immediate Tax Loss
decision_matrix.rationale: Triggers immediate ~35%–37.1% combined Federal (20% LTCG + 3.8% NIIT + 25% §1250) + California (up to 13.3%) tax hit (plus 4.45% Measure ULA if >$5.4M in LA City), permanently destroying ~1/3 of compounding principal.
decision_matrix.source_label: IRS NIIT / Capital Gains Rules & CA FTB Pub 1067
